description: This Java source file defines the HashCrypt utility class for SHA-1 and PBKDF2 hash encryption, including methods for hashing, comparing passwords, and handling hash formats.

classes.name: HashCrypt
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for SHA-1/PBKDF2 hash encryption, password comparison, and hash format handling.

methods.name: comparePassword
methods.description: Compares a hashed password with a plaintext password, supporting multiple hash formats.

methods.name: doCompareTypePrefix
methods.description: Handles comparison for hashes with type prefix, e.g., {SHA}...

methods.name: doComparePosix
methods.description: Handles comparison for POSIX-style hashes with salt and type.

methods.name: doCompareBare
methods.description: Handles comparison for bare hash strings.

methods.name: cryptPassword
methods.description: Deprecated method for hashing passwords with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptUTF8
methods.description: Hashes a string value with specified hash type and salt, supporting PBKDF2.

methods.name: cryptValue
methods.description: Hashes a string value with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptBytes
methods.description: Generates a hash for byte array with specified hash type and salt, returning formatted string.

methods.name: getCryptedBytes
methods.description: Computes hash bytes using specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: pbkdf2HashCrypt
methods.description: Creates PBKDF2 hash string with specified hash type, salt, and value.

methods.name: doComparePbkdf2
methods.description: Verifies PBKDF2 hashed password against stored hash.

methods.name: getSalt
methods.description: Generates a random salt string.

methods.name: digestHash
methods.description: Computes hash of a string with optional encoding.

methods.name: digestHash
methods.description: Computes hash of byte array with specified hash type.

methods.name: digestHash64
methods.description: Computes base64-encoded hash of byte array with specified hash type.

methods.name: getHashTypeFromPrefix
methods.description: Deprecated: Extracts hash type from prefixed hash string.

methods.name: removeHashTypePrefix
methods.description: Deprecated: Removes hash type prefix from hash string.

methods.name: getDigestHashOldFunnyHexEncode
methods.description: Deprecated: Encodes hash using old funny hex format.

methods.name: digestHashOldFunnyHex
methods.description: Hashes string and encodes using old funny hex format.

methods.name: oldFunnyHex
methods.description: Encodes byte array into old funny hex string format.
